row.scim_plan: Strata Cloud Manager Essentials (with NGFW / Prisma Access, Contact Sales)
row.team_price_text: Included at no cost with NGFW, software firewall and SASE (all quote-only)
row.evidence: Palo Alto Networks documents SCIM for Strata Cloud Manager access management ("Strata Cloud Manager supports integration with the following SCIM providers: Sailpoint OCI Okta"), but publishes no prices; Strata Cloud Manager Essentials is "free with the purchase of NGFW and Prisma Access".
row.notes: Quote-only: Palo Alto Networks publishes no prices; Strata Cloud Manager (the common admin console for NGFW and Prisma Access, with Common Services: Identity & Access) comes free as Essentials with NGFW, software firewall and SASE purchases, with Pro as a paid upgrade. SCIM is configured in Common Services for the tenant and documented for SailPoint, OCI and Okta (Okta via a custom SWA app with SCIM, base https://api.sase.paloaltonetworks.com/iam/v1/scim, OAuth 2.0 client credentials from a service account); the SCIM page does not tie it to Pro. Once SCIM is enabled, access changes are allowed only through the SCIM provider. Groups link to existing predefined roles (no group creation); removing a user needs a manual Okta group push. Entra ID, Google Workspace, OneLogin, Ping and other SAML IdPs are documented for SSO only. Research covers Strata Cloud Manager / Common Services; other products (Prisma Cloud / Cortex Cloud, Cortex XSIAM/XDR) have separate user management not researched here.

scim.plan: Strata Cloud Manager Essentials (with NGFW / Prisma Access, Contact Sales)

auth.token_source: Common Services > Identity & Access: service account (IAM Administrator or Superuser role) in a Tenant Service Group; client ID and secret used with the client-credentials token endpoint https://auth.apps.paloaltonetworks.com/am/oauth2/access_token

operations.notes: Okta actions: Import New Users, Push New Users, Push Profile Updates, Push Groups (Link Group only), Import Groups. Deactivate is not among the documented actions; removal happens through group membership.

group: roles (predefined access policies) imported as groups

roles.how: IdP groups are linked (not created) to predefined Strata Cloud Manager roles imported from the tenant; membership assigns the role

limitations.text: No group creation over SCIM; groups must be linked to existing predefined roles.
Removing a user from an Okta group needs a manual Push Now, or the user keeps access.
With SCIM enabled, all access-management changes must go through the SCIM provider; IdP-managed users cannot be removed in the console.
SailPoint connector XML is supplied by the account representative.

scim.notes: Users' email domains must be verified by a Strata Cloud Manager Identity Federation (OCI guide). SCIM version is not stated.

methods: oauth2 client credentials (service account) bearer token

endpoints.purpose: Assign an access policy to a user or service account

okta.notes: Palo Alto's guide builds a custom SWA app with SCIM provisioning enabled, not an OIN catalogue app.

entra.notes: Common Services documents Entra ID SAML for authentication and authorization; no SCIM.

open_questions: No public prices; whether SCIM needs Strata Cloud Manager Pro rather than Essentials is not stated.
SCIM version, token lifetime, filtering, pagination and supported user attributes beyond userName are not documented.
Whether SCIM supports deactivate (active=false) or DELETE, and whether removal ends sessions, is not documented.
Entra and JumpCloud provisioning are not documented; Okta OIN listing for Strata Cloud Manager was not checked.
Prisma Cloud / Cortex Cloud and Cortex XSIAM/XDR have their own user management and may document SCIM separately; not researched.
